en.headline: HKMA says 280 global financial leaders to gather in Hong Kong next week
en.dek: Eddie Yue said the fifth Global Financial Leaders’ Investment Summit from 2 to 4 November will focus on rethinking the playbook for markets and technology.
body: Hong Kong Monetary Authority chief executive Eddie Yue said the authority will host the fifth Global Financial Leaders’ Investment Summit from 2 to 4 November, bringing together approximately 280 global financial leaders, including around 120 group chairpersons and chief executives.

Yue wrote that the summit offers an opportunity for high-level dialogue and closer ties across the international financial community. The programme begins with a welcome dinner on 2 November, the main summit on 3 November, and a Conversations with Global Investors forum on 4 November co-hosted with the Securities and Futures Commission and the Hong Kong Academy of Finance.

Participants will discuss macroeconomic trends, financial market shifts and technological advances that create opportunities and risks across sectors, asset classes and regions. Yue said the leaders would also see first-hand how Hong Kong is rethinking its playbook to strengthen its role as an international financial centre, including as a leading offshore renminbi hub, a more active fixed-income market, a resilient digital-assets and payments ecosystem, and new openings in gold and commodities.
The HKMA said preparations are well advanced and it looks forward to welcoming both returning and new guests.

zh.headline: 金管局：約280位國際金融領袖下周聚港
zh.dek: 余偉文表示，第五屆國際金融領袖投資峰會將於11月2日至4日舉行，主題圍繞市場與科技的「思變圖新」。
body: 香港金融管理局總裁余偉文表示，金管局將於11月2日至4日舉辦第五屆國際金融領袖投資峰會，匯聚約280位國際金融領袖，包括約120位集團主席及行政總裁。
余偉文指，峰會為高層次對話及深化全球金融界聯繫提供機會。活動由11月2日歡迎晚宴開始，3日舉行主峰會，4日則由金管局、證監會及金融學院合辦「與國際投資者對話」研討會。
與會者將討論宏觀經濟趨勢、金融市場變動及科技發展，為不同行業、資產類別及地區帶來的機遇與風險。余偉文表示，領袖們亦可親身體會香港如何「思變圖新」，強化國際金融中心地位，包括深化離岸人民幣樞紐、推動固定收益市場、完善數碼資產及支付生態，以及開拓黃金和大宗商品業務。
金管局指籌備工作順利推進，期待新舊賓客到訪。
